events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Action needed: migration is paused after batch 3 because the new CRM incorrectly added +1 to overseas phone numbers. Of 120 records migrated, 31 have wrong numbers; batches 4–10 (280 records) would have the same issue. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, though it is not known whether they opened affected records. Recommend identifying the 31 records, verifying their correct country codes against authoritative sources, correcting them, and fixing or confirming the migration approach before resuming. Please advise who can supply the correct numbers and authorize the remediation approach.
